movement.instructions: If enemy_dy is negative (enemy above Mario) and enemy_dx is within64 pixels, choose dodge_left to avoid walking underneath a falling enemy. Otherwise choose brake_left when retreating and drop_px is below32. Also choose brake_left when blocked and wall_height exceeds headroom. Otherwise choose run_right. Null means absent.

criteria.dodge_left: Step left to avoid a nearby enemy falling from above.

enemy.instructions: Classify the enemy spacing and height. Do not jump into an enemy above Mario; stay below it.

criteria.B: The enemy is more than three body lengths away, OR it is above Mario (negative vertical offset).
criteria.C: The enemy is within three body lengths and is at the same height as Mario or below (nonnegative vertical offset).

enemy_low.instructions: Classify the enemy spacing and height. Do not jump into an enemy above Mario; stay below it.

criteria.B: The enemy is more than two body lengths away, OR it is above Mario (negative vertical offset).
criteria.C: The enemy is within two body lengths and is at the same height as Mario or below (nonnegative vertical offset).

wall.instructions: Classify whether the wall requires a jump now. A wall taller than ceiling_clearance_px cannot be jumped over from here.

criteria.B: The wall is more than three body lengths away, or cannot be cleared because its height exceeds ceiling clearance.
criteria.C: The wall is within three body lengths and there is enough clearance to jump over it.

criteria.B: The pit is far away: more than three body lengths ahead.
criteria.C: The pit is close: within three body lengths.

air.instructions: Which direction is Mario moving vertically?
